description: This file defines the interface ConnectionProperties outlining the properties for a serial connection, including methods to get and set baud rate, data bits, stop bits, parity, and connection timeouts.

methods.name: getBaudRate
methods.description: Returns the baud rate for the connection.

methods.name: setBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate for the connection.

methods.name: getDataBits
methods.description: Returns the number of data bits used in the connection.

methods.name: getStopBits
methods.description: Returns the number of stop bits.
